title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 17.1.7 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8,…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 17.1.7 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 could cause sensitive credential values submitted in GraphQL requests to be logged in plaintext due to incomplete filtering of sensitive data. This issue has been remediated by GitLab.
